services.detail: The treatments page lists Shockwave, also called extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT). The clinic page says a course is usually 3–6 sessions, and each application lasts 5–10 minutes within a visit of up to half an hour.
The treatments page lists joint manipulation and mobilisations, and soft tissue techniques.
The treatments page lists return to sport, core stability, core strength and traditional strength training.
